description:
About Aiwyn

Aiwyn is the first complete platform for modern Accounting Firms. Backed by top-tier investors like Bessemer, KKR, and Revolution, we're one of the fastest-growing scale-up SaaS companies in the world. We build category-defining technology, and we're doing it with world-class people, processes, and products. To learn more, visit our website.

We work with the majority of the Top 500 firms in the country. We're modernizing the software accounting firms rely on every day, replacing decades-old systems and brittle infrastructure with tools they can trust.

The role

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team responsible for building and operating the cloud infrastructure that powers Aiwyn.

This team owns our infrastructure foundations, from internal development environments and tooling to production systems, staging environments, and customer-facing integrations. We need someone who can help define our technical direction and build scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure that grows with the business.

Our platform runs primarily on GCP, using Cloud Run, GKE, PostgreSQL on Aiven, Pulumi, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

You'll partner closely with Product Engineering, Productivity, Security, and Integrations to understand their needs and build infrastructure that enables their success. We're product-focused, AI-forward, and believe infrastructure should make engineering easier, not create unnecessary friction.

What good looks like

  • Infrastructure scales with the business. We have a clear architectural vision and make thoughtful investments that support growth without unnecessary complexity.

  • Security, durability, availability, and performance are built in. These are foundational requirements, not afterthoughts.

  • The right way is the easy way. Golden paths, automation, and reusable components make infrastructure consistent, secure, and increasingly self-service.

  • Our environments are reliable and secure. Development, staging, production, and customer integration environments meet the needs of the teams and customers depending on them.

  • Infrastructure is a product. We understand our internal customers, work closely with partner teams, and build capabilities that deliver meaningful value.

What you'll do

  • Lead and grow the team. Coach engineers, set a high technical bar, build accountability, and develop a team that takes ownership.

  • Own the infrastructure vision and roadmap. Guide architectural direction, prioritize investments, and align infrastructure strategy with business needs.

  • Build scalable cloud foundations. Lead decisions across compute, networking, databases, identity, access management, and environments, balancing reliability, security, performance, and cost.

  • Drive automation and standardization. Build repeatable infrastructure through infrastructure-as-code, golden paths, and self-service capabilities.

  • Own operational excellence. Improve observability, SLOs, incident response, disaster recovery, and system resilience. Focus on preventing recurring problems, not just responding to them.

  • Partner across engineering. Work with Product Engineering, Productivity, Security, and Integrations to deliver infrastructure that supports our products and engineering workflows.

  • Embrace AI. Identify opportunities to use AI to improve infrastructure engineering, automation, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency.

What we're looking for

  • Experienced engineering leader. You've managed infrastructure teams, developed engineers, set clear expectations, and delivered through your team.

  • Strong technical background. You've built and operated cloud infrastructure and production systems at scale. You can guide architecture, challenge assumptions, and evaluate technical tradeoffs.

  • Cloud and infrastructure expertise. You understand distributed systems, networking, databases, infrastructure-as-code, and modern cloud-native architecture.

  • Security and reliability mindset. You understand secure architecture, SRE principles, observability, resilience, and what it takes to operate dependable production systems.

  • Product mindset. You treat infrastructure as a product, understand the needs of the teams using it, and focus on delivering capabilities that make a difference.

  • AI-forward thinking. You're actively using AI in your work and understand both its potential to improve engineering and the risks that come with it.

  • Strong judgment and communication. You can make sound technical decisions, navigate competing priorities, and work effectively across engineering and product teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with GCP, GKE, Cloud Run, Pulumi, or Terraform.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience supporting multi-tenant SaaS platforms and customer-facing integration environments.

  • Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, and disaster recovery.

Interview process

We'll share a detailed interview plan with you on the intro call. The loop is designed to mirror the actual job: real artifacts to react to, conversations that look like the conversations you'd have on the team, and reference checks taken seriously. We'll move quickly when there's mutual fit.

Why Work at Aiwyn?

  • The big-picture value proposition of this role is simple: join us, and you'll be paid competitively to have freedom in solving worthwhile, challenging problems alongside other A-players at a fast-growing SaaS startup led by an experienced and successful team with industry experience

  • AI-by-Default - you'll have access to best-in-class AI tools and work in an environment that embraces an AI-by-default mindset, where curiosity and experimentation are part of how we operate

  • Remote-first organization

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Stock options

  • 401(k) matching

  • Adventure Travel Stipend on each anniversary of your employment with Aiwyn

Our Values:

  • Relentless by Design

  • Owners not Renters

  • Trust at the Core

 

Aiwyn is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

 

Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our CCPA privacy notice which can be found here: https://www.aiwyn.ai/ccpa
